 # ===========================================================================
 # SELF-HOSTING — a Rian DECLARATION front-end, written in Rian (Stage 2)
 # ===========================================================================
-# Beyond expressions (selfhost_parse.rian), this parses the declaration forms a
-# program is made of — `type` sum declarations and `def` functions — into a
-# `Decl` representation. Projected to `Rian.IR` by the test, it (a) matches what
-# `Rian.Decl.parse` builds, and (b) is handed to the real backend
-# (`Rian.Beam.compile_ir/2`) which compiles and RUNS it — the Stage-2 thesis
-# (ADR-0063): a Rian front-end producing IR the existing backend consumes.
+# Parses the declaration forms a program is made of into a `Decl` representation
+# that, projected to `Rian.IR` (the test), matches what `Rian.Decl.parse` builds
+# and is compiled + RUN by the real backend (`Rian.Beam.compile_ir/2`) — the
+# Stage-2 thesis (ADR-0063): a Rian front-end producing IR the existing backend
+# consumes, with no Elixir parse in the loop.
 #
-# Core declaration grammar (token stream = injected `Rian.Lexer.tokenize/1`):
-#   program := (decl NL*)*
-#   decl    := 'type' Id ':=' variants | 'def' Id '(' params ')' Id ':=' expr
-#   variants:= variant ('|' variant)*
-#   variant := Id | Id '(' typelist ')'
-#   params  := ε | (Id Id) (',' Id Id)*          # `name Type`, simple types
-#   expr    := the precedence-climbing expression parser (binops, unary, calls)
+# Forms covered:
+#   type Name := V1 | V2(T, …)                         sum declarations
+#   def name(p [cap] Type, …) Ret := expr              single typed clause
+#   def name(p [cap] Type, …) Ret                      bodiless signature
+#   def name(pat, …) := expr                           pattern clause (multi-clause)
+#   patterns: _  ·  var  ·  Int literal  ·  Ctor(pat, …)  ·  nullary Ctor (nested)
+#   capabilities: val / iso / ref / tag (default val)
 #
-# Out of slice (the long tail of Rian.Decl): multi-clause `def` + clause patterns,
-# capabilities (`val`/`iso`/`ref`), parametric types (`Vec(T)`), block bodies,
-# guards, `mod`/`struct`/`alias`/`const`/`protocol`/`impl`, `forall`, doc-comments.
+# Out of slice (the long tail of Rian.Decl): `when` guards, parametric param types
+# (`Vec(T)`), cons/list/string/char patterns, negative-literal patterns, block
+# bodies, and `mod`/`struct`/`alias`/`const`/`protocol`/`impl`/`forall`/doc-comments.

+  # collect tokens up to the matching `)` (depth 0), returning (inside, rest).
+  def take_parens(ts Vec(Tok), depth Int64, acc Vec(Tok)) Paren

+  def parse_param(ts Vec(Tok)) ParamRes
+  def parse_param([TId(n), TId("val"), TId(t) | rest]) := PR(Par(n, "val", t), rest)
